narrative.overview:
A quiet portfolio where an exact 12-column grid and light Raleway type do all the work, and the real work (nine shipped sites with their stack) sits at the center. The palette is warm white, stone and sage with no accent color; hierarchy comes from weight, size, 1px rules and background steps between warm and sunken bands.

Everything is flat: zero shadows, 1px borders, 4px corners, and screenshots shown unadorned with square corners. Motion is one fade-up on the hero and 0.2s color and border responses elsewhere. Green, amber and red exist only for functional states; the one live use is the availability dot in the hero. Secondary text is #6B6560 rather than ZenGrid's #78716C because #78716C fails 4.5:1 on the sunken band; Stone #78716C survives only as the primary button fill and non-text.
keyCharacteristics: No accent color: Warm White #FAF9F6, raised #FFFFFF, sunken #F5F4F1, Stone text ramp, Sage for borders only.
Raleway 300 for H1/H2 and the hero name, Raleway 500 for H3/H4, DM Sans for everything else, Fira Code for technology names only.
Flat: zero shadows, 1px borders (Sage at 45% default, #A8A29E strong, #57534E focus), 4px radii, square image cards.
12-column grid, 24px gutters, 1280px container, section padding clamp(72px, 10vw, 120px), warm and sunken bands alternate.
One entrance (hero fade-up 16px, 0.6s, reduced-motion safe); all other motion is a 0.2s color or border change.

rules.name: The Stone Text Rule
rules.body: Text and headings are Stone Dark #57534E. Secondary and metadata text is #6B6560, which holds 4.5:1 on Warm White and on the sunken band. Sage #A8A29E is never text; Stone #78716C is only the primary button fill and non-text marks.

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only for functional states (availability dot, invalid field, errors). No decorative accent.

rules.name: The Display Once Rule
rules.body: The .display size (Raleway 300, up to 72px) belongs to the hero name alone. Every other heading uses the H1 to H4 scale.

rules.name: The Mono Means Technology Rule
rules.body: Fira Code sets technology and stack names only, never decoration or generic labels.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows or gradients. Depth is a 1px border or a step between warm, raised and sunken. Hover changes a border or background, never position.

rules.name: The Bare Image Rule
rules.body: Project screenshots have square corners, no border, no overlay and no tint.

dos: Do build on the 12-column grid with 24px gutters and left-align large text blocks.
Do set text in #57534E and secondary or metadata text in #6B6560.
Do use Sage (#A8A29E) for borders and dividers only, at 45% for default and full for strong.
Do separate sections with vertical space clamp(72px, 10vw, 120px) and alternate warm and sunken bands.
Do use 4px radii (6px for the chat panel) and Stone primary, bordered secondary, ghost buttons in sm, md and lg sizes.
Do keep the hero fade-up as the only entrance and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, gradients or overlays.
Don't use Sage or Stone #78716C for text.
Don't introduce an accent color; semantic colors are for states only.
Don't use the display size or weight 300 below H2 outside the hero name.
Don't fall back to the default dev-portfolio look: dark page, neon accent, decorative monospace, icon-topped cards.
